notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 dimension lookup foundation to the exact official C++ RTIambassador declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies signatures, declared exception sets, adapter symbols, and a real Catch2 selector. The implementation is limited to FOM-defined dimension names, upper bounds, inherited available-dimension lookup, and stable per-federation handles. Region lifecycle/range services, DDM routing, timestamped/retraction behavior, save/restore, remote transport, packaging, catalog evidence, validation, and conformance remain outside this slice.
